descricao.curta: More than half of the course is downhill, so maxing Wit is highly recommended. The spurt phase also starts on a straight section, which makes front-runners somewhat weaker due to the lack of Seiun.
descricao.analise_meta: Since front-runners don't have Seiun and the race is a sprint, Pace Chasers naturally have an advantage. End Closers also have access to a lot of strong acceleration skills, so this track basically comes down to Pace vs. End.

Front.rec_accel: 1. Pasa + Machan 2. final push (Unrestrained),  ignited PWR
Front.rec_skills: Prioritize GW, 3 Lanes, and Leader's Pride. Final Push isn't strong, only around a 20% chance of getting a good activation. You can still take it if you want some additional acceleration, though.

Pace.rec_skills: If you're not using Nishino, try to get Highlander, Head-on, or Ignited PWR for extra acceleration. Even with Nishino, picking up additional acceleration skills is still viable, but it's mostly a matter of preference.

Late.rec_skills: King (Cheer)+LS is a must. Try to get Full Throttle (0.25).

End.rec_skills: King (Cheer), Spurt, LS, and Witful (UW) are all must-have skills. Running all of them together is highly recommended, and it isn't over-acceleration since this is a sprint race.

cartas.alternativa: or teio if you think it's over accel

Front.rec_skills: GW, 3 Lanes, leader pride, after that just use any speed skills  that's the cheapest (corner skills is easiest to use).

cartas.alternativa: ^Tachyon should be better if you can't reach high rating fronts

End.rec_accel: 1. Spurt 2. LS/Unrivaled Wits 2. Ryan 3. King (Cheer) 4.Forward, March!
